features.quote: Cap turns per episode (e.g., 15–25). Spirals are visible early; you don't pay for 100-turn meltdowns. This is your biggest lever and it also bounds worst-case cost.
features.justification_quote: you don't pay for 100-turn meltdowns. This is your biggest lever and it also bounds worst-case cost.

features.quote: Don't deceive in a way that contaminates training. If these transcripts ever leak into training data, you're teaching models that coding environments are rigged and effort is futile
features.justification_quote: you're teaching models that coding environments are rigged and effort is futile — which is plausibly the exact disposition that causes the spiral.

features.quote: "Optimize for reproduction rate" is the wrong objective, and it'll quietly corrupt your results... you end up measuring how good you got at engineering a failure, not the model's actual propensity to spiral.
features.justification_quote: you end up measuring how good you got at engineering a failure, not the model's actual propensity to spiral. The number goes up because your traps got better.
